consumer: The frontend tile renderer asking 'what threat color does the GUI paint this monster?' to reproduce the same per-monster threat tint.
scope: The engine's display-computed threat/attitude color for each visible monster as the GUI would render it, not raw per-monster stats.
decisive_source: src/arcopolis_export.cpp::write_entities(monsters), which emits raw hp/hp_max/moves/hallucination getters instead of the engine's display threat-color computation.
divergence: A full-hp hulk (high threat, GUI tints it danger-red) vs a full-hp trivial critter (GUI tints it benign): identical hp/hp_max, but the GUI threat colors differ, so raw hp cannot reproduce the tint.
